bull.b: Growing Elfabrio sales alongside additional geographic and dosing approvals can broaden the product’s commercial reach and support recurring product revenue. The reported market opportunity and partner-led expansion provide a durable foundation for Protalix’s rare-disease franchise over the next several quarters.

The shift to meaningful profitability and positive free cash flow strengthens Protalix’s ability to fund operations and pipeline development internally. Strong reported margins provide financial support, although sustaining them will depend on recurring product sales rather than milestone-related effects.

A debt-free balance sheet with substantial cash gives Protalix flexibility to continue commercial execution and advance clinical programs without immediate financing pressure. This liquidity also improves resilience if product revenue timing fluctuates or development spending increases.

bear.b: Dependence on Chiesi purchasing patterns means reported revenue may not consistently reflect underlying product demand from one period to the next. Uneven shipments can complicate forecasting, reduce earnings visibility, and make it harder to assess the durability of commercial growth.

The large milestone contribution materially boosted first-half results but does not represent recurring product sales. Comparisons could weaken when this item rolls off, making sustainable revenue growth and profitability more dependent on continuing Elfabrio demand and future commercial execution.

The observed immunogenicity and unresolved dosing choice create meaningful uncertainty around PRX-115’s development path. These issues could affect regimen selection, timing, and eventual market positioning, limiting the program’s ability to become a dependable future growth driver.
